annotations.title: Find hospices by ZIP code, place or name

description: OpenHealth finds Medicare-certified hospices. A 5-digit ZIP code returns the hospices Medicare lists as serving that ZIP code. A city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a two-letter state returns hospices with an office there. A name narrows either search. OpenHealth returns up to 10 hospices ordered by Medicare's family caregiver survey star rating, then by name. Each result includes the hospice's CCN and page link. OpenHealth adds no grade of its own.

name.description: Part of the agency's name, such as Ashtabula Regional.

place.description: A 5-digit ZIP code, a US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a two-letter state code.
